notes.title: Orendale UI Overhaul
notes.content:
[h1]🚀 UI Overhaul – Orendale’s New Look[/h1]

Greetings, adventurers!

It’s been a while since our last update — but the wait has been worth it. Over the past few months, we’ve been working hard on revamping Orendale’s interface, bringing it closer to the tone and future-forward style of the game’s universe.

After much deliberation, we’ve decided to shift toward a **more futuristic UI design**, in line with Orendale’s **science fiction roots** rather than a traditional medieval aesthetic.


[h2]📸 Before & After Showcase[/h2]

To show how far we’ve come, here are four examples comparing the old and new UI side-by-side:

[b]1. Main Menu Overhaul[/b]  
The original layout placed the Story/Adventure button in the center and stacked three battle mode buttons beneath it. This felt visually cramped, so we restructured the entire layout.  
Now, all battles are accessed through a new, centralized **FIGHT** button, creating a cleaner and more intuitive interface.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131134/ee17b01121f867a174b1a4b565170fbbd9892c28.png[/img]

[b]2. Forge Menu Revamp[/b]  
We wanted to retain the Forge’s simplicity but give it a sleeker look. The updated design improves both clarity and aesthetics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131134/609629781731f8e231132d9046105e150b683121.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131134/6cb1145421f5c4c1461bea6364b9ca99671ae878.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131134/863dc9e0ba2533ccf58743f44012308a34a90074.png[/img]

[b]3. Abilities Menu Refresh[/b]  
A complete redesign that maintains the original spirit while enhancing usability and visual identity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131134/4d74fd23fa987d5d5b10e7d6e3231b58adaabcf2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131134/f20da63c526f0c2d69f25d305c3bfcf56a7b425a.png[/img]

[b]4. New Fight Selector[/b]  
The new FIGHT button opens a full selector menu, where you can choose any battle mode. We’ve also added **reward previews** to help players plan more effectively.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131134/690debb5534a8ace652489bb4be42cb0f6fb1410.png[/img]

Battles:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131134/276afe22ecab00d51f155058ee910e9ed43b9150.png[/img]


[h2]🛠 What’s Coming Next?[/h2]

Next up on our agenda is a **full equipment overhaul**. In addition to redesigned gear, we’re introducing a powerful new system:

[b]⚙️ Runes[/b]  
Runes will allow for deep customization, influencing your team’s stats, synergy, and overall combat strategy.

[b]🗡 Weapon Abilities[/b]  
Weapons will soon come with **unique abilities**. These can be paired with runes to unlock strategic combos and combat depth.


Thank you for being part of the Orendale journey. This is just the beginning — and we’re excited to share much more with you soon!

[center]💬 Join the discussion in our [url=https://discord.gg/24V6K4xVqX]Discord[/url] and follow us for future updates![/center]

[center]– The Orendale Team[/center]

notes.title: Orendale's Future Roadmap
notes.content:
With Steam Fest behind us, we are beyond grateful for the incredible support from our players—thank you! Your feedback has been invaluable, and we’re working hard to crush bugs and implement your most-requested features.

As we move forward, we’d like to share our vision for the future. Below is our official roadmap for the release of Orendale, highlighting the features and content we're committed to delivering by launch.

Once again, thank you for being a part of this journey! If you’d like to stay updated, consider wishlisting Orendale and following us on social media or joining our Discord community.

[b]Roadmap: Q3 2025 - Orendale 1.0 Release[/b]

[b]Complete UI Overhaul[/b]: A fresh, thematic redesign for a more immersive experience
[b]Zone 0 Completion[/b]: 10 new areas, each offering unique challenges
[b]Additional Ally Combatants[/b]: 2 new allies for each area
[b]Exclusive Gear Sets[/b]: New gear unique to each area
[b]New Game Modes[/b]: Dungeon runs, Wave battles, and Survival mode, in addition to Story, Training, and Boss battles
[b]2 New Classes[/b]: Expanding strategic options and playstyles

[b]Online Features:[/b]
Account creation
World chat for global player interaction
Leaderboard to rank your achievements
Friend list to connect with fellow players
Cross-save support: Seamlessly transition between mobile and PC
Thank you again for all your support! Your input shapes Orendale, and we’re excited to keep building it together.

Happy adventuring,
The Wendel Studios Team

notes.title: Orendale Demo Now Available for Steam Fest!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, adventurers![/b]
We’re thrilled to announce that the "Orendale" demo is now live and part of Steam Fest! For those eager to embark on a challenging, fantasy turn-based RPG journey, this is your chance to dive into the opening area of our world.

[b]About the Game:[/b]
"Orendale" is a fantasy turn-based RPG where players must overcome tough, tactical battles while uncovering a deeply engaging story. The game world is divided into zones and areas, each with its own unique challenges and lore to explore. In this demo, you’ll experience Area 1 of Zone 0, the starting point of your journey—a small taste of the grand adventure that awaits!

[b]What's Next?[/b]
We’re excited to make Orendale accessible to players all over the world. We’ll be monitoring where players are joining from and working to make the game available in those languages! Don’t forget to invite your friends to join the adventure as well.

[b]Support Us:[/b]

Wishlist "Orendale" and try the demo now!
Leave feedback via comments or reviews to help us improve the game before the full release in 2025.
Join our Discord to build a fun and engaging community. At Wendel Studios, we love interacting with players and listening to your suggestions and ideas!
The demo is currently available on Steam for PC, Mac, and Linux. The full release in 2025 will also bring Orendale to mobile platforms!

Check out our trailer and view a few screenshots to get a glimpse of what’s in store.

Happy adventuring,
The Wendel Studios Team
